rules.statement: There is no right of appeal against an order of the District Court made under section 16 of the Recovery of Loans by Banks (Special Provisions) Act No. 4 of 1990.
rules.supporting_quote: There is no right of appeal against an order of the District Court made under section 16 of the aforesaid Act.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 16 of the Recovery of Loans by Banks (Special Provisions) Act No. 4 of 1990
